'''Desten''' was an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with five [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Abo]]. It was located within the [[Lehon system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] area known as the [[Tempered Wastes]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Desten was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Desten, in grid square G-11.<ref name="TEA" />
